paper_id: Shangguan et al. - 2015 - ShopMiner Mining Customer Shopping Behavior in Physical Clothing Stores with COTS RFID Devices
title: ShopMiner: Mining Customer Shopping Behavior in Physical Clothing Stores with COTS RFID Devices
motivation: Physical stores only have sales history, missing pre-checkout behaviors like browsing, picking up, and matching items
problem_framing: Detect three behavior types: popular category (viewed items), hot items (picked/turned), correlated items (matched together)
key_insight: Phase readings of RFID tags show distinct stable patterns when body blocks LOS link, enabling non-invasive behavior sensing
method_signature: Foreground segmentation + KL-divergence segmentation + DDTW clustering on phase time-series
evaluation_criteria: TPR 92% for popular items, 94%/87% accuracy for pick-up/turn-over, 85%+ for correlated items
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: False alarm rate breaks 40% without variance filtering; cannot distinguish employee from customer via RF signals
evidence_for_taste: the phase value changes significantly when the LOS path is blocked
ShopMiner is unable to distinguish employees and customers
performance of ShopMiner can degrade dramatically in crowded stores
thinking_moves: 把感知问题重新frame成通信问题：利用body shadowing对RF链路的影响
将用户行为建模为物品状态变化（stationary→kinetic），相位响应随之改变
先证相位噪声服从Gaussian分布，再设计假设检验方案
借鉴图像处理中前景检测的思路来处理phase frame
通过实验发现pick-up与turn-over对邻近物品的不同影响（是否被连带推动）
主动承认RSS-based方法在此场景下不可靠，选择phase时序相似性替代
